description: This file defines the ContentEntityForm class, a Drupal core class that manages form operations for content entities, including creation, validation, revision handling, and multilingual support.

classes.name: ContentEntityForm
classes.description: A Drupal core form class for managing content entity forms, including creation, editing, validation, revision handling, and multilingual support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ContentEntityForm with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: prepareEntity
methods.description: Prepares the entity before form rendering, e.g., hiding revision log messages.

methods.name: getBundleEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the bundle entity associated with the content entity.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form array for content entity editing, including revision and language support.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating the entity's changed timestamp.

methods.name: buildEntity
methods.description: Constructs the entity object from form values, handling revisions and validation requirements.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the entity based on form input, filtering violations and setting errors.

methods.name: getEditedFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names that are being edited in the form.

methods.name: flagViolations
methods.description: Flags validation violations on the form, associating errors with specific fields.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes form state and entity, including translation and display settings.

methods.name: initFormLangcodes
methods.description: Initializes language code values for the form based on entity translation.

methods.name: getFormLangcode
methods.description: Returns the current language code for the form.

methods.name: isDefaultFormLangcode
methods.description: Checks if the form's language code is the default entity language.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form input values into the entity object.

methods.name: getFormDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the form display configuration from form state.

methods.name: setFormDisplay
methods.description: Sets the form display configuration in form state.

methods.name: updateFormLangcode
methods.description: Updates the form's language code based on entity language changes.

methods.name: updateChangedTime
methods.description: Updates the entity's changed timestamp if it supports EntityChangedInterface.

methods.name: addRevisionableFormFields
methods.description: Adds revision-related fields to the form if revision UI is enabled.

methods.name: getNewRevisionDefault
methods.description: Determines whether a new revision should be created by default.

methods.name: showRevisionUi
methods.description: Checks if revision UI should be shown for the entity.
